description: At night Almagro's Plaza Mayor lies mostly in darkness — no floodlit spectacle here. Warm light spills from a few terrace taverns beneath the twin galleries of green wooden columns, catching the Town Hall's lit windows at one end. The rectangular square, once a market and bullring, settles into quiet, and the famed galleries glow only where the evening crowd lingers. Travellers note the square's night lighting is modest — honest and unhurried.
